steps.name: project-setup
steps.summary: Next.js 15 App Router 골격, Vitest 설정(test/setup.ts), mock 랜딩(src/app/(marketing)/page.tsx)을 루트에 추가함

steps.name: design-tokens
steps.summary: DESIGN 토큰을 globals.css의 --surface/--text/--cat-* 변수로 옮기고 Pretendard, theme 초기화, Button, categories.ts(CATEGORIES/CATEGORY_COLORS/CATEGORY_TOKENS/toCategory)를 추가함

steps.name: db-schema
steps.summary: Supabase 마이그레이션 20260817072000_init.sql/20260817072100_rls.sql/20260817072200_storage.sql로 8개 테이블, enum(transaction_category, transaction_type, upload_job_status, subscription_status, spending_signal_type), RLS/Storage 정책을 만들고 src/types/database.ts의 Database 타입을 생성함

steps.name: auth
steps.summary: Supabase createBrowserClient/createServerClient(src/services/supabase.ts)와 server-only createServiceRoleClient(src/services/supabase-service-role.ts), evaluateEntitlement(input), /dashboard·/settings 로그인 미들웨어(api/static 제외)를 추가함

steps.name: csv-parse
steps.summary: src/lib/csv에 encoding/parse/date/amount/mapping/sanity/dedupe 순수 함수와 thresholds.ts를 추가함; ParsedRow={rowIndex,transactedOn,amount,merchantRaw,merchantNormalized?,transactionType,raw}, 임계값은 src/lib/csv/thresholds.ts

steps.name: merchant-classify
steps.summary: normalizeMerchant, MERCHANT_SEED_RULES/matchSeedRule, resolveCategories, OpenAI 래퍼(OPENAI_MODELS, CLASSIFY_BATCH_SIZE=100, sanitizeMerchantName, classifyMerchantBatch, inferColumnMapping)를 추가하고 OpenAI SDK는 vi.mock으로 모킹함

steps.name: signals
steps.summary: src/lib/signals의 Signal={type,period,targetKey,impact,payload}와 detectSignals(input) 진입점을 추가하고 RPC get_category_monthly_totals/get_period_transactions/get_category_amount_medians/get_merchant_history/get_seen_merchants_before_period를 추가함

steps.name: inngest-pipeline
steps.summary: 업로드 라우트 4종(signed-url·start·[id]·mapping)과 /api/inngest, Inngest 워커 process-upload(step.run 9개, 분류는 배치당 스텝 1개)를 추가하고 openai.ts에 describeSignals를 더함. AC(db reset·build·lint·test 190)는 세션 중단 후 수동 검증으로 통과 확인
